description.value: Open Kitchen is a large, multi-station residence dining hall inside UBC's Orchard Commons, open to the public and not just students. It offers five concurrent food stations spanning flatbreads and baked pasta, stir-fry, Asian noodle dishes, grill favourites, and fresh sandwiches, drawing on Vancouver's diverse culinary scene. More than 60% of ingredients are sourced locally from UBC Farm and other BC producers, with certified halal beef, Ocean Wise seafood, and a dedicated range of vegan and vegetarian options.
